judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and four failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` (note the ticket asked for `registry.test.ts`). No production code was modified at all: `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is untouched and `ajv` was never added to `package.json`. Consequently, all four added tests fail and the test suite is broken. Furthermore, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, or `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were performed.
